title.zh: 将Silay市Capitan Ramon描笼涯的Dmlmhs分校分离出来，单独改设为独立的Capitan Ramon描笼涯国立中学，并为此拨付所需经费
title.en: An Act Separating the Dmlmhs-capitan Ramon Extension High School in Barangay Capitan Ramon, City of Silay, From the Doña Montserrat Lopez Memorial High School, Silay City, and Converting It Into An Independent National High School, to Be Known as the Barangay Capitan Ramon National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The DMLMHS-Capitan Ramon Extension High School in Barangay Capitan Ramon, City of Silay, is hereby separated from the Doña Montserrat Lopez Memorial High School, Silay City, and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Barangay Capitan Ramon National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
All personnel, assets, liabilities, and records of the DMLMHS-Capitan Ramon Extension High School are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Barangay Capitan Ramon National High School.
The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
